name: wrg-sigma-rules
description: Sigma detection rule writing, validation, and conversion for SOC analysts and threat-intel teams. LLM-assisted draft + pySigma validation + multi-backend conversion (Splunk, Elastic, OpenSearch, Wazuh) with logsource-aware processing pipelines. Ships a 330-rule published corpus spanning 17 MITRE ATT&CK tactics, covering ransomware and threat-actor activity as well as vulnerabilities disclosed in AI/LLM applications and MCP servers.
